title: Warm-up
description: Welcome to the CTF! Type your own username to validate your first flag.
hint: It is shown in the bottom-left corner of the portal.

title: HTTPS
description: A user cannot reach an internal web app over TLS. Which TCP port does HTTPS use by default?

title: Proxy authentication
description: A browser receives an HTTP error asking it to authenticate against a proxy. What is that HTTP status code?
hint: It is in the 4xx range, right after 406.

title: DNS over IPv6
description: Which DNS record type maps a hostname to an IPv6 address?
hint: The IPv4 equivalent is a single letter.

title: Access denied
description: The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it. Which HTTP status code is returned?
hint: Not 401: the client may already be authenticated.
